names.note: Name page 14295 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Андрей (Аргунов), мч.»; the grade is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «мч. Андрея». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and no folder in this corpus carries «Аргунов» in any form.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», a single year standing for both men of the entry; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера и мч. Андрея (1938).»

attestations.note: The second man of the day's fifth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line grades him «мч.» alone, with no priestly rank and no see, so `martyr` is all that is written and NO `office` IS WRITTEN. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*argunov*` is empty and a Cyrillic grep for «Аргунов» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
